list_id.description: The `list_id`s of the items to fetch.

filter.description:
Filters the returned results according to the value of the specified field,
using the `<field name>:<field value>` syntax.

namespace_type.description:
Determines whether the returned containers are Kibana associated with a Kibana space
or available in all spaces (`agnostic` or `single`)

search.description: Free-text search term applied to exception list item fields (for example a hostname or file path fragment).

per_page.description: The number of exception list items to return per page

sort_field.description: Determines which field is used to sort the results.

sort_order.description: Determines the sort order, which can be `desc` or `asc`.
